title: Figs. 12-13: Gemini MSC-3 Tri-Axis Magnetometer and MSC-10 Two-Color Earth's Limb camera
description: Two photographs from NASA document M-913-65-04. Fig. 12, "MSC-3 TRI-AXIS MAGNETOMETER," shows a fluxgate magnetometer installation in the spacecraft adapter assembly. Fig. 13, "MSC-10 TWO-COLOR EARTH'S LIMB PHOTOS," shows a hand-held camera with a cable release used to photograph the Earth's limb through red and blue filters.
